idea-plugin.name: Alignator
idea-plugin.description:
Vertically aligns arguments in C# code: arguments of constructor, function and attribute calls, values of named arguments, dictionary-style entries in collection initializers, and assignments in with expressions.

Each alignment has its own setting, configurable under Settings > Editor > Code Style > C# > Others or via .editorconfig (csharp_alignator_* keys). All alignments run on ReSharper's built-in column-alignment engine and require its int_align_invocations switch.
